_readme: Config template for the LinkedIn post generator. Copy to ~/.hermes/scripts/linkedin_config.json to activate; or place config.json in a redirect directory and point LINKEDIN_TEMPLATES_DIR at it. With no live config file anywhere, all four scripts (linkedin_render.py, linkedin_voicebook_check.py, linkedin_lever_check.py, voice_guard.py) behave byte-identically to their built-in defaults.

_notes.url_allowlist: Regex list; any match marks a URL public (used by the LINK slot gate, the checker link-line gate, and selection viability). app.notion.com is always rejected in code, regardless of config.
_notes.template_dir: Only consulted when LINKEDIN_TEMPLATES_DIR is not set; the env var wins.
_notes.ollama_url: Full /api/embed endpoint used by voice_guard.py; defaults to the local URL above.
